Interpreter builds copied from the [emglken](https://github.com/curiousdannii/emglken) npm package (v0.7.2) by `tools/build-vendor.mjs`.

- `git.js` / `git.wasm`: Git (Glulx) by David Kinder, MIT, with RemGlk-rs (MIT) and Emglken glue (MIT).
- `bocfel.js` / `bocfel.wasm`: Bocfel (Z-machine) from garglk, MIT, with RemGlk-rs (MIT) and Emglken glue (MIT).

`LICENSE` is Emglken's own license file. Only the MIT-licensed interpreters are shipped here.
